grounded/stone.reason: Pale fractured stone reads as rock at 32 px; lit planes and grain replace the jewel-like old facets.

grounded/wood.reason: Bark, cut end and end-grain hold at 64 px; a broad warm log silhouette remains at 32 px.

grounded/wheat.reason: Fuller ears and separated highlights keep the crop legible at 32 px and add convincing grain at 64 px.

grounded/fish.reason: Silver scales and a clear tail replace the bright blue polygon fish and its ground shadow.

grounded/labor.reason: A gripping hand and working hammer fill the square better than the distant full-body worker.

grounded/essence.reason: The bottle remains clear at both sizes. Glass and violet volume improve at 64 px; the old magenta bottle is equally distinct at 32 px.

grounded/ironwood.reason: Dense bark and red end-grain distinguish it from ordinary wood; the old black log has comparable contrast at 32 px.

grounded/fragment.reason: The orange-green shard retains its identity; surface light improves at 64 px but the old silhouette is already strong.

grounded/knight.reason: The steel bust has readable helmet and shoulders at 32 px; the old full-body knight loses those details.

grounded/crossbowman.reason: The weapon silhouette survives reduction better than the old tiny figure. It names the troop by equipment.

grounded/paladin.reason: Blue and white shield reads cleanly and has stronger material depth. It trades the old mounted silhouette for a defensive emblem.

grounded/realm.reason: Stone gate and slate roofs establish a material building instead of a monochrome gold token. Level remains an external badge.

grounded/camp.reason: Both tents read at 32 px. The new canvas has stronger folds at 64 px without adding another visual object.

grounded/hyperstructure.reason: Stone spires and the lit core give the site material depth missing from the flat old emblem.

grounded/chest.reason: Wood and iron separate clearly at both sizes, replacing the all-gold chest with a readable object.

grounded/move.reason: Leather boots retain material detail at 64 px. The old footprints are faster as a pure sign at 32 px.

grounded/explore.reason: The map and lens have convincing depth; the old eye is simpler at 32 px. The map distinguishes this from a watch-only spyglass.

grounded/attack.reason: A lit blade is clean and free of the old shield frame. Its narrow silhouette is less prominent but remains legible at 32 px.

grounded/build.reason: The mallet and block match the shipped material quality; removing the second tool makes the 32 px subject cleaner.

grounded/trade.reason: The iron balance keeps the familiar scale silhouette with clear pans. Small chains still merge at 32 px as in the old art.

grounded/stamina.reason: Amber depth is stronger at 64 px; the old lightning silhouette is equally clear at 32 px. This meaning is reserved for stamina.

grounded/victory.reason: Laurel, cloth and pale material carry a victory subject with painted depth instead of the flat old trophy.

grounded/settings.reason: One iron gear reads more clearly than the framed dial and key, with enough face shading to feel physical.

grounded/chat.reason: Two painted speech forms preserve the conversation meaning and remove the gold rim; ivory faces stay clear at 32 px.

grounded/map-army.reason: An unframed helmet preserves a compact military silhouette; painted light replaces the old shield engraving.

grounded/map-realm.reason: A broad gate and crenellations preserve the site silhouette while leaving ownership to the surrounding shape.
